channel.title: Eri on BLINK
channel.description: Recent content in Eri on BLINK

item.title: Aris
item.description:
Eri’s mentor and surrogate father. Knows the ancient texts and the properties of obsidian and the void. He makes the void vials and the dissolution tonic.

Beyond

He dies in the castle siege, spending his last void vial to seal Lachesis safe. The mob kills him. Eri feels his life-thread snap, and the grief triggers her breakthrough blink.

item.title: Burill
item.description:
Daughter of Mello, sixteen or seventeen, captain of the Everwind. Brash, teasing, light Doric accent. Eri’s closest friend from the sea years.

Beyond

She was laughing, and then she was dead – killed by a unicorn’s iridescent horn.

item.title: Issah
item.description:
Mercenary. Deadpan, economical, a death-wish underneath. Travels east with Eri.

Beyond

His little brother Urmez starved to death in his arms. He earned the Dragon Slayer title through Malachar’s willing sacrifice. He kills Rhodes at the climax.

item.title: King Lachesis
item.description:
King of Kraeta. Eri’s father. Cold and distant on the surface; a fierce, hidden love underneath – a lock of her hair, birthday letters never sent.

Beyond

He holds the Golden Path and saw that Eri was the only thread that defeats the unicorns. He engineered everything to armour her against Rhodes’s paradise: the anchor, the hard life, the pirate years. He is trapped in a void bubble mid-book.

item.title: Mello
item.description: Captain of the Pirates of Eleutheria. Weathered, fond, a father-figure. Took Eri in for the King’s seasoning and called her and Burill proper sailors.

item.title: Queen Hren
item.description:
Queen of Kraeta. Eri’s mother. Rhodes says she leapt from a cliff.

Beyond

Rhodes lies. She gave herself to his cause, and when her usefulness ran out he discarded her to the homunculi. Her arc mirrors Eri’s: both offered paradise, both forced to choose.

item.title: The Anchor
item.description:
A mark set on Eri’s forehead by her father when she was four.

Beyond

It is what unlocks the blink.

item.title: The Blink
item.description:
Eri enters the thread dimension and transports to where a person once physically stood, found along their lifeline thread.

Location, not time. It has a cost.

Beyond

The cost is emotional hollowing. The still-point – going empty – is how she masters it, and it is what empties her.

item.title: The Still Point
item.description:
Control through release. To blink cleanly, let the feeling go.

Beyond

It is the tragic loop: releasing emotion to blink is exactly what hollows her. She saves the world and loses the ability to feel it.
